name: Coral Idol Chamber
description: A natural chamber lit by reflected light. In the center lies a coral idol, abandoned as if dropped in haste long ago.

interactables.name: coral idol
interactables.examine_text: A coral carving worn smooth by time. It feels oddly warm when you touch it.

take.empty_text: The idol is no longer here.

interactables.name: stone panel
interactables.examine_text: One panel looks slightly misaligned. There's a gap thin as a fingernail.

success.success_text: You find a hidden passage and slip through.

search.fail_text: You find nothing but smooth stone.
